purpose: Preview only; no addon UI changes

prompts.prompt: Create a high-fidelity UI DESIGN MOCKUP, landscape 16:9, for the WoW Forever addon Mapperly using the exact restrained Classic WoW visual language of the attached Gatherly screenshot. This is an illustrative concept, not a shipped screenshot. Reference 1 Gatherly Preferences screenshot defines the materials, type and controls: native dark grey stone/leather background, warm opaque grey inset surfaces RGB49,46,41, fine aged bronze/stone edging, cream Friz-style serif text, gold headings. Reference 2 Gatherly Routes screenshot provides the parchment map visual vocabulary only. Reference 3 Mapperly toolbar sheet provides the existing painted icon shapes, reuse them visually. Reference 4 Mapperly logo provides branding only: a small round crest in the title bar, never a large logo covering map. Show a very large windowed Mapperly world map in a dim wooded WoW game scene, with game visible around ALL edges, roughly 8% screen margins. The map itself occupies almost the whole window with no wide ornamental border or blank filler; only a slim title bar, fine trim and slim coordinate footer. Zone map is Duskwood: tan parchment, muted green hills, roads, river, forest, Darkshire, Raven Hill, Twilight Grove; a few clear small hearthstone, envelope, blue portal, winged boot and quest markers, a player arrow. Top left heading exactly 'Duskwood (18-30)'. Thin right-hand vertical toolbar of eleven small, distinct painted gold icons on flat warm grey square backgrounds, minimal padding, no chunky borders: close, resize, parent map, locate, navigation, add note, filters, quest log, reveal, lock, settings. Right quarter of the map window has an open native-looking quest list matching Gatherly's warm grey inset panel and fine bronze edging; title 'Quest log', search field, a few legible quest entries and yellow checks, with comfortable spacing. Footer left exactly 'Player: 80.2, 55.8 | Cursor: 27.3, 26.4'; footer right 'Mapperly'. No red row of buttons across the map; reserve native red only for tiny close control. Keep map dense and useful, polished but restrained; no modern dashboard styling, no glass, no oversized decorative fantasy frame, no huge compass. Add a small outside-caption at bottom 'MAP VIEW - THEME MOCKUP'.

Create a high-fidelity UI DESIGN MOCKUP showing TWO complete Classic WoW addon windows side by side, landscape wide composition, legible straight-on UI, on a neutral dim game background. These are Mapperly's proposed Settings and Map notes windows themed to match Gatherly. Reference 1 Gatherly Preferences screenshot is the visual style authority: restrained native PortraitFrame stone/bronze trim, dark leather/stone body, warm opaque grey inset panels RGB49,46,41, dark fields RGB38,37,33, cream Friz-style serif body text, muted warm grey hints, gold headings, standard native checkbox ticks and thin dark sliders, native red primary action buttons. Do NOT redesign as a modern SaaS app. Reference 2 Mapperly note icon sheet provides the exact twelve painted icon symbols; reuse just those symbols with NO text captions beneath or next to individual icons. Reference 3 Mapperly logo is branding only: a small portrait crest at top left of each window, not an oversized logo. Left window title 'Mapperly - Settings', subtitle 'Map appearance and location layers'; native tabs 'Map appearance' active and 'Location layers'. Inset section 'Map display' has checkboxes 'Coordinates', 'Reveal unexplored areas', 'Lock map position', 'Show quest log'. Section 'Map and markers' has a slider 'Compact map size' value '100%' ends '50%' and '110%'; another slider 'Map marker size' value '18 px' with a live preview showing hearthstone, envelope, winged boot and blue portal symbols. Section 'Compact map opacity' has 'Stationary' value '100%' and 'Moving' value '65%'. Footer quiet button 'Reset position' and native red primary button 'Done'. Right window title 'Mapperly - Map notes', native tabs 'Edit note' active and 'My notes'. Inset editor with location 'Duskwood - 80.2, 55.8'; labels and inputs 'Name' value 'Our meeting spot', 'Group (optional)' value 'Friends', 'Description (optional)' value 'Meet here before the dungeon.' Below, 'Map icon', hint 'Use any symbol for any purpose.' Then exactly twelve painted icon-only choices in TWO rows of SIX: skull, chest, blue flag, green mountains/sun, red-roof house, warning triangle; campfire, paired flags, pickaxe/crystals, blue fish, cave, signpost. Absolutely no names or purposes on these icons. Blue flag selected with a thin gold highlight, not thick boxing. Selected icon small preview near Map icon heading. Footer native red 'Save note', quiet grey buttons 'Navigate', 'Delete note', 'Cancel'. Both windows should feel like siblings of the supplied Gatherly panel: muted warm greys, proper native frame material, thin trim, red sparingly for primary actions only. No ornate giant gold frames, no gradients on quiet buttons, no labels under icons. Bottom outside caption 'SETTINGS AND NOTES - THEME MOCKUP'.
